title: the CSV reader sets aside a cut or ragged export

findings.claim: a CSV export cut inside its last row: that lab result is served with its value cut short and no sample time; nothing counted
a CSV export that ends inside a quoted field (no closing quote): the last note is served cut short; nothing counted
a CSV row one field short is mapped with the missing column taken as empty; nothing counted
a complete CSV export that does not end with a line end, or ends with a DOS end-of-file byte, now holds the night where master read it
a CSV export cut exactly at a line end (whole rows lost) cannot be told from a whole file and is served, as on master
